title: Spyglass: Officially Launched & Enhanced!
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, now fully enhanced and ready to empower you with powerful new insights.

title: Master Your Embedded Files
summary: Gain complete command over all your files directly within the editor, with new options to easily upload, download, and adjust how they are displayed.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Stay informed about our journey with a dedicated new roadmap page that transparently showcases our completed work, upcoming features, and future plans.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to interact with, and seamlessly integrated them into our modern interface, making task management more intuitive than ever.

title: Enhanced Collaboration for Teams
summary: Experience effortless teamwork with our newly enhanced collaboration features, designed to make working together more intuitive and enjoyable.

title: Seamless Collaboration and Discovery
summary: Effortlessly share and find relevant items, fostering seamless collaboration and discovery within your network.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: Empower a global audience with Noeko, now featuring robust support for a wide array of international languages.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We are open-sourcing Noeko's codebase to empower our users with maximum control and direct involvement in the project's future, fostering unparalleled transparency.

title: Dynamic Graph View: Discover Connections Faster
summary: Experience a more powerful graph view with dynamic filtering by tags and time, plus integrated sharing visibility, making it easier than ever to explore and manage your knowledge and kickstart your workflows.

title: Advanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Unlock precise knowledge discovery with powerful filtering capabilities for tags and dates, and effortlessly save your tailored insights into custom collections called Compendiums.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Experience a powerful new way to structure and organize your notes with dynamic display options that bring your connected content to life.

title: Noeko: General Availability with Flexible Plans and Self-Hosting
summary: We are thrilled to officially launch Noeko, introducing flexible paid plans and the highly anticipated option to host it on your own servers for unparalleled control.

title: Elevated Aesthetics: New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Prepare for a beautiful visual refresh with an expanded collection of elegant new themes and meticulous enhancements to your existing favorites, crafting a truly personalized and delightful interface.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Time of Day
summary: Get ready for smarter greetings that accurately reflect the time of day, making your experience even more tailored and delightful.

title: Enhanced Tag Organization & Quick Actions
summary: Manage your tagged items with greater ease by directly unapplying tags and performing other useful actions from within the tag view, streamlining your workflow.

title: Expanded Content Source Integration
summary: Soon, you'll be able to seamlessly integrate and learn from a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge like never before.
